name: Grace Nakato
message: Hello! I would like to volunteer for the upcoming water well project in Karamoja. I have experience in community outreach and can commit two weekends per month. Please let me know how to get involved.

name: David Mwangi
message: We are a small business in Nairobi interested in sponsoring the education program. Could someone contact us about corporate partnership tiers and tax documentation?

name: Sarah Mitchell
message: I made a donation yesterday via bank transfer (ref TXN-88421). Can you confirm it was received? Thank you for the incredible work you do.

name: Rev. Peter Okello
message: Our congregation would like to host a fundraising dinner for Tattu Care. We expect about 120 attendees. Do you have materials or a speaker who could join us?

name: Amara Diallo
message: Question about the hygiene kits drive — are you still accepting in-kind donations of soap and toothbrushes? I can arrange a shipment from Kampala.

name: James Ochieng
message: Please update my receipt email to jochieng@company.co.ke — I used the wrong address when donating. Amount was USD 500.

name: Linda Chen
message: I'm a public health student looking for a field placement. Does Tattu Care accept interns for the maternal health program? Available June–August 2026.

name: Michael Torres
message: Great website! Quick suggestion: adding a monthly giving option would make it easier for diaspora supporters like me to contribute regularly.

name: Christine Abiyo
message: Hello Tattu Care team! I work with another NGO in Uganda and would like to explore partnership opportunities. Our organization focuses on maternal health. Can we set up a meeting?

name: Samuel Kipchoge
message: I want to organize a fundraiser in my community. Can you send me some promotional materials about the water projects?

name: Thomas Kabuye
message: Our school would like to include Tattu Care's work in our social studies curriculum. Could you provide educational materials about your impact?

name: Fatima Hassan
message: Interested in supporting your healthcare program. What are the current health challenges in the communities you serve?
